### Fix direction
This is an app-side bug/flaw (not a test bug): `SyncComponent` should not deterministically alternate a user-visible "sync unavailable" state purely off a launch counter with no real sync check behind it. Either the app logic needs fixing, or (if intentional test scaffolding) the test needs to force `launchCount` to a known parity (e.g., clear app data before each run) before asserting the button's visibility.'
